newsitem.title: UK: T&N in U.S. bearings venture with Daido Metal.
newsitem.headline: T&N in U.S. bearings venture with Daido Metal.

text.p: Britain's T&N Plc said on Tuesday it had agreed a joint venture in the U.S. with Japan's Daido Metal Company for the production and supply of bearings to Japanese car makers in the U.S.
As part of the agreement, T&N will retain a 70 percent stake in Glacier Vendervell Inc's bearings operation in Bellefontaine, Ohio, while Daido will hold the rest.
The venture will start trading as Glacier Daido America at the beginning of next year.

Boosted by Daido's "in-depth" knowledge of Japanese engine technology, the venture will "ensure that our customers receive an unrivalled quality of service and engineering expertise," said T&N's chief executive Ian Much in a statement.
